prompt: A photorealistic 16:9 frame from a handheld night camera jostled inside a protest crowd on a hot Asuncion street in November, lit by one orange sodium streetlight overhead, with dozens of raised phone screens dotting the dark, light grain. Squeezed shoulder to shoulder, a presenter in a burnt-orange rib-knit wool balaclava is being carried sideways by the crowd, still holding a big foam-covered microphone out at arm's length toward nobody in particular. The knit covers his whole head in one continuous unbroken surface, its fuzz glowing in the streetlight, the neck tucked into a damp, rumpled black suit jacket. A cream-white felt ring is stitched around the face area, and one small solid red felt triangle with rounded corners sits high inside it at two o'clock, on the right side of the image. His black leather gloves each carry a small stitched patch of the same white ring and red triangle on the back. Sweaty ordinary people in T-shirts press around him, a few holding up blank pieces of cardboard. Thanks.
